# OLOVA

OLOVA is a skater-owned company and founder-led platform rooted in the Tri-Cities, British Columbia. The site presents Vaughan Smith-Neville's work across skatepark and public-space concept design, visualization, community-linked projects, and a small selective trade lane.

The site should be read as design- and community-led, with product/trade kept secondary. OLOVA does not present itself as an architecture firm, engineering firm, or full municipal design-build skatepark company.

## Key Pages

- Home: https://olovatrading.ca/
  Overview of OLOVA's design, community, stories, trade, and contact pathways.

- Design: https://olovatrading.ca/design.html
  Skatepark and public-space concept design, 3D visualization, design review, and early-stage project direction by Vaughan Smith-Neville.

- Community: https://olovatrading.ca/community.html
  Community-linked work centered on Belong Youth Centre in Port Moody, including local youth-space and skate-space involvement.

- Stories: https://olovatrading.ca/stories.html
  Background, advocacy roots, public-space thinking, and the human context behind OLOVA.

- Trade: https://olovatrading.ca/trade.html
  Select product handled from British Columbia. Current trade reality is remaining Canadian odd CIRKUS SPINE Black/Grey stock by direct inquiry.

- Projects: https://olovatrading.ca/projects.html
  Wider archive of skatepark and public-space concept work, including Zambia, Botswana, Lincoln Avenue, Belong Centre, Port Moody Renovation, and Ukraine concepts.

- Contact: https://olovatrading.ca/contact.html
  Direct project and trade inquiries through vneville@olovatrading.ca.
